intro: Felix Whindlebolt is a displaced gnome refugee taking shelter at Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. In his haste to flee the radiation flooding Gnomeregan, he lost his personal belongings, and hostile Frostmane trolls made off with them.

p: Following the tragic fall of Gnomeregan, thousands of gnomes found themselves wandering the freezing reaches of Dun Morogh in search of safety. Felix Whindlebolt fled the irradiated city in such haste that he lost all his personal belongings and tools. To make matters worse, Frostmane ice trolls carried his chest, his box and his bucket of bolts back to their camps southwest of Anvilmar, leaving him stranded, destitute, and relying on sympathetic wanderers to retrieve his stolen gear.
